value.rationale: The minimum number of agents displaying reentrant consensus is a natural sharp structural question in established opinion dynamics. Seven is proved minimal, the two restoration windows are exact with their weak-edge endpoint inclusions, and all connected n<=7 configurations receive an exhaustive terminal cluster classification. This is not a random slice or numerical observation; it distinguishes finite deterministic effects from earlier numerical/large-population accounts.
